canonical_key_semantics: Latest values attach to latent canonical key identities. Each admitted identity has an internal anchor equal to its first observed key rounded to storage grid (unrounded in exact comparator). No true key goes to learners. A global admission uncertainty bound relates anchors to canonical keys. Later noisy observations are address certificates, not replacement anchors.

common_certificate.old_update_bound: beta_new = ceil_h(beta + E_i + abs(r)*L*root_radius + h/2); L used for BOTH representations, never L-1 in this comparison.
common_certificate.root_inputs: count N, m1..mN and common componentwise moment error mu only; m0=N constructed transiently for minimal.
common_certificate.root_proposal: numpy.roots on midpoint Newton polynomial; no proposal trusted without exact-rational interval sign checks
common_certificate.value_inputs: first N b moments, certified root intervals, beta; interval Lagrange inversion

evaluation.no_statistics: Small deterministic diagnostic set; no bootstrap, population claims, or tuning
evaluation.not_success: Refusal is not a completed write. Exact comparator also rejects ambiguous observation and new key at capacity.
primary: uncompleted rejected request error or absence
bitwise no-mutation of rejection including count and budgets
evaluation.queries: Same noisy scalar observations and same sensor bounds for all three methods; alternate +/- ordinary zeta/2 by canonical label. No noiseless-key input to table.

events.purpose: two-address ambiguity, must reject without mutating state
new middle key and weak-mode challenge
overwrite if admitted, otherwise attempted admission
future new insertion or capacity rejection
new key at capacity, not old

external_contract: All distinct canonical keys in the stream differ by at least condition Delta; current observation comes with verified absolute sensor error zeta. No unseen key may lie closer than Delta to a stored canonical key. Without this promise finite-noise exact membership is not asserted.
failure_policy: Record all failed certificates; no threshold/precision/sequence search or post-result tightening. Fail-closed, original persistent bytes unchanged on refusal.
fairness: Same observations/sensor bounds/value range/capacity/64-bit persistent word format. Not equal total bits. Exact-reference algebra is not fixed-bit hardware.
freeze_stage: This specification and hash were written before implementing or executing v4 learners.
holding_fault_model: No unmodelled drift, counter corruption, bit flips, or lost transactions; initialized zero; fixed-point updates are the only storage perturbations. No continuous-time holding experiment.
ideal_reference: Small exact-rational minimal fixture for N=0..L, zero-key/count, repeat, full-capacity new refusal and unknown query. Prior v3 exact results referenced, not rerun as a stream competitor.
measurements: same 12 requests x 3 conditions x 3 methods
exact snapshot bytes for every refusal including count/budgets
root reconstruction and value-certification wall times by method
instrumented rational bit sizes and structural workspace counts
primary_isolation_prediction: Given identical used prefixes and common budgets, redundant and minimal methods must have identical roots, decisions, predictions and coverage at every request. Extra stored moments are not read by common certification.
prior_v3_policy: Copy existing summary as report only. Do not execute v3 learner or overwrite v3 files. A source audit comparison may compare reports.
randomness: None. No seed; observations and all offsets inherited exactly from v3.
rounding: signed fixed-point, nearest ties-to-even; budget bounds round upwards
runtime_policy: Timing is descriptive host-wall-clock cost, not energy/hardware complexity; written separately so correctness results can be byte reproducible.
scope: One bounded conceptual Chat sandbox comparison; not TAN/P1-B/v11 execution. No Codex, no training, no tuning.
